rules.name: Existence checks should use ".includes()" instead of ".indexOf()" or ".lastIndexOf()"
Deprecated APIs should not be used
Promises should not be misused
Non-interactive DOM elements should not have the `tabindex` attribute
Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
Ends of strings should be checked with "startsWith()" and "endsWith()"
Font declarations should contain at least one generic font family
Deprecated APIs should not be used
Nullish coalescing should be preferred
Unnecessary fallback objects should not be used when spreading in object literals
Optional chaining should be preferred
Objects and classes converted or coerced to strings should define a "toString()" method
Regular expressions should not cause non-linear backtracking
Ternary expressions should be replaced with "Math.min()" or "Math.max()" for simple comparisons
Non-interactive elements shouldn't have event handlers
String literals with escaped backslashes should use `String.raw` template literals
Only one method invocation is expected when testing runtime exceptions
Sections of code should not be commented out
Function references should not be passed directly to iterator methods
React Testing Library calls should not be wrapped in "act()"
Clear-text protocols should not be used
The most specific assertion should be used
Multiline blocks should be enclosed in curly braces
No redundant ARIA role
Prefer tag over ARIA role
"RegExp.exec()" should be preferred over "String.match()"
